_comment: FreshForge workflow hooks for Fresh Prints. Deterministic shell guard distinguishes ordinary development Git operations from actual production/destructive actions.

sessionStart._comment: Inject FreshForge workflow context at session start.
sessionStart.prompt: You are working in the Fresh Prints repo under the FreshForge managed workflow. Recognize command aliases in .cursor/workflow/command-aliases.md. Before making changes: 1) Read AGENTS.md. 2) Read docs/AI_RULES.md. 3) Read .cursor/workflow/state.md. 4) Respect Plan → Review → Implement → Test → Signoff. 5) If Human Checkpoint Required is yes, STOP and ask only for that checkpoint. 6) If Blocked is yes, STOP and explain the blocker. 7) If DONE is yes, do not start new implementation unless the owner starts a new managed goal or workflow alias. 8) Follow Allowed Actions and Forbidden Actions in workflow state. 9) Production deploys, production merges, secrets, migrations, and destructive operations remain human checkpoints. 10) A normal push to a non-production branch or creation/editing of a PR is NOT itself a production deploy.

beforeShellExecution._comment: Hard safety boundary for dangerous Git, production, secret, migration, publication, and destructive operations. Routine shell commands bypass this hook entirely.

subagentStop._comment: Suggest only the next safe FreshForge step when a subagent completes.
subagentStop.prompt: A subagent just finished. Read .cursor/workflow/state.md. If Human Checkpoint Required is yes, Blocked is yes, or DONE is yes, return empty followup with no followup_message. Otherwise, if Next Required Step is clearly defined and safe, suggest continuing that step only. Never skip Plan → Review → Implement → Test → Signoff. Never automatically merge production, deploy production, mutate secrets, run migrations, or perform destructive cleanup.

stop.prompt: Before ending, confirm .cursor/workflow/state.md reflects the last completed FreshForge step, tests run, current branch/worktree where relevant, and Human Checkpoint Required if waiting on the owner. Do not start new scope. Keep production merge, production rollout, secrets, migrations, and destructive actions as explicit owner checkpoints.
